column1: # OWASP ZAP rules for the scans tests/e2e/run.sh runs with DEVBUDDY_E2E_ZAP=1 (Phase 14, C4).
# Each line: rule id, TAB, level, TAB, (rule name), TAB, why. ZAP reads the id and the level, and
# shows the why beside the finding in its report.
# How a run is judged:
#   - A rule listed FAIL fails the run when it raises a finding.
#   - A rule not listed at all is WARN, ZAP's default, and run.sh fails the run on a warning too. A
#     finding nobody has looked at is not accepted by being new.
#   - A rule listed IGNORE is accepted. Every IGNORE below says why, and the owner triaged them on
#     2026-09-26 from the scans of the run that fixed the first findings.
#   - Separately, run.sh fails the run on any unhandled exception the API logged while it was
#     scanned, because that is where a 500 comes from, and rule 100000 below cannot tell a 500
#     from a 401.
# What each scan judges, found by a control run on 2026-09-26: the baseline judges findings at
# every level, informational included, and the API scan judges Low and above only. An
# informational finding from the API scan is in its report and never fails the run, whatever this
# file says about its rule.
# To accept a new finding, add it here as IGNORE, with its reason, in the change that explains it.
# To stop accepting one, change it to FAIL or delete the line.
# Fixed after the first scans, and listed so that a regression fails by name.
# Accepted, each by design.
